dogecoin.text: Dogecoin it is. What else do I have to lose?

Ethereum miners need to find a solution to sustainably mine their coins bc what matters more is our environment instead of all those long blockchains processing through energy intensive hardware. Dogecoin is more efficient and secure. Much less harm to the environment.

Dogecoin is basically performing the same functions as bitcoin and ethereum (use as a store of wealth), in fact I’d say better (environmentally at least), yet it gets laughed at while it continues to rocket up. It’s the same damn ponzi/speculative asset.
Dogecoin is the most environmentally friendly cryptocurrency outside of XRP but XRP is banned in the US.

I think dogecoin is now the gold standard in crypto. However doge goes, so goes the rest of crypto. Just breached support at .36. Next stop .30, then 0.25. If below 0.25, it falls all the way down to 0.07. Good to know how low it can go
